description: This script automates the generation and validation of documentation for plugins based on their changed files, including handling header files and JSON output files. It supports incremental updates by analyzing a list of changed files and generating relevant documentation sections accordingly.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts plugin name from a given file path based on known directory structures.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Validates that JSON changes in 'apis/' have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/', returning validation status and missing plugins.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Determines which plugins need documentation regeneration based on changed files, categorizing them by file types.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Handles the actual documentation generation process for a given plugin, from headers and JSON files, including invoking external scripts.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs postprocessing on generated markdown files to clean up specific sections.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the documentation sidebar by calling an external script.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that coordinates validation, plugin processing, documentation generation, postprocessing, and sidebar update based on input arguments.
